parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key (1-128 printable ASCII characters), one per logical submit; a retry reuses it. A repeat of the same request replays the first response with the header Idempotency-Replayed: true; the same key with another method, path or body is 409 idempotency-key-reused. A missing key is 400 idempotency-key-required, a malformed one 400 idempotency-key-invalid. Keys are kept for 24 hours. vendor-connectivity sends its transactionId.
